title: Video
description: Convert, trim, split, redact and grab frames, with preview windows. Needs ffmpeg for most.

actions.label: MP4
actions.command: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -i "$INPUT" -vf "scale='trunc(iw/2)*2':'trunc(ih/2)*2'" -c:v libx264 -crf 20 -preset medium -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 160k -movflags +faststart "$(fw_out "$DIR/$NAME.mp4")"

actions.label: H.265
actions.command: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -i "$INPUT" -vf "scale='trunc(iw/2)*2':'trunc(ih/2)*2'" -c:v libx265 -crf 28 -preset medium -x265-params log-level=error -tag:v hvc1 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart "$(fw_out "$DIR/$NAME-hevc.mp4")"

actions.label: Frames
actions.description: Pick and save frames as PNG, with a preview
actions.command: case "${INPUT:e:l}" in mp4|mov|m4v) open "flickwheel://video?mode=frame&path=$(perl -e 'print join q(), map { /[A-Za-z0-9_.~-]/ ? $_ : sprintf(q(%%%02X), ord) } split //, shift' "$INPUT")";; *) r=$(osascript -e 'text returned of (display dialog "Frame at (seconds or m:ss)" default answer "0" buttons {"Cancel","Grab"} default button "Grab" with title "FlickWheel")') || { echo Cancelled >&2; exit 1; }; r=${r// /}; [[ $r =~ ^[0-9:.]+$ ]] || { echo 'Use seconds or m:ss' >&2; exit 1; }; out="$(fw_out "$DIR/$NAME-frame.png")"; rm -f "$out"; ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -ss "$r" -i "$INPUT" -frames:v 1 "$out"; [[ -s $out ]] || { echo 'No frame at that time' >&2; exit 1; };; esac

actions.label: 720p
actions.command: ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -i "$INPUT" -vf "scale=-2:'trunc(min(720,ih)/2)*2'" -c:v libx264 -crf 22 -preset medium -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart "$(fw_out "$DIR/$NAME-720p.mp4")"

actions.label: Trim
actions.command: case "${INPUT:e:l}" in mp4|mov|m4v) open "flickwheel://video?mode=trim&path=$(perl -e 'print join q(), map { /[A-Za-z0-9_.~-]/ ? $_ : sprintf(q(%%%02X), ord) } split //, shift' "$INPUT")";; *) r=$(osascript -e 'text returned of (display dialog "Trim: start-end (seconds or m:ss), e.g. 0:05-0:20. End is optional." default answer "0:00-" buttons {"Cancel","Trim"} default button "Trim" with title "FlickWheel")') || { echo Cancelled >&2; exit 1; }; r=${r// /}; s=${r%%-*}; e=${r#*-}; [[ $r == *-* && ${s:-0} =~ ^[0-9:.]+$ && ( -z $e || $e =~ ^[0-9:.]+$ ) ]] || { echo 'Use start-end, e.g. 0:05-0:20' >&2; exit 1; }; t=(); [[ -n $e ]] && t=(-to "$e"); ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -i "$INPUT" -ss "${s:-0}" "${t[@]}" -vf "scale='trunc(iw/2)*2':'trunc(ih/2)*2'" -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 160k -movflags +faststart "$(fw_out "$DIR/$NAME-trim.mp4")";; esac

actions.label: Speed
actions.description: Change the speed with a live preview
actions.command: case "${INPUT:e:l}" in mp4|mov|m4v) open "flickwheel://video?mode=speed&path=$(perl -e 'print join q(), map { /[A-Za-z0-9_.~-]/ ? $_ : sprintf(q(%%%02X), ord) } split //, shift' "$INPUT")";; *) r=$(osascript -e 'text returned of (display dialog "Speed (0.5 to 100): 2 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half speed" default answer "2" buttons {"Cancel","Go"} default button "Go" with title "FlickWheel")') || { echo Cancelled >&2; exit 1; }; r=${r// /}; [[ $r =~ ^[0-9]*[.]?[0-9]+$ ]] && awk -v f="$r" 'BEGIN{exit !(f>=0.5 && f<=100)}' || { echo 'Use a number from 0.5 to 100' >&2; exit 1; }; ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -i "$INPUT" -filter:v "setpts=PTS/$r,scale='trunc(iw/2)*2':'trunc(ih/2)*2'" -filter:a "atempo=$r" -c:v libx264 -crf 20 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 160k -movflags +faststart "$(fw_out "$DIR/$NAME-${r}x.mp4")";; esac

actions.label: Split
actions.description: Cut into clips at chosen points
actions.command: case "${INPUT:e:l}" in mp4|mov|m4v) open "flickwheel://video?mode=split&path=$(perl -e 'print join q(), map { /[A-Za-z0-9_.~-]/ ? $_ : sprintf(q(%%%02X), ord) } split //, shift' "$INPUT")";; *) echo 'Split needs mp4, mov or m4v: convert with MP4 first' >&2; exit 1;; esac

actions.label: Redact
actions.description: Cover areas of the video for a time range
actions.command: case "${INPUT:e:l}" in mp4|mov|m4v) open "flickwheel://video?mode=redact&path=$(perl -e 'print join q(), map { /[A-Za-z0-9_.~-]/ ? $_ : sprintf(q(%%%02X), ord) } split //, shift' "$INPUT")";; *) echo 'Redact needs mp4, mov or m4v: convert with MP4 first' >&2; exit 1;; esac
